name: 1Password CLI
description: Installs 1Password CLI with optional auto SSH key configuration

vault.description: Default vault name to use. Sets OP_VAULT_NAME environment variable.

vaultID.description: Default vault ID to use. Sets OP_VAULT environment variable. Preferred over vault name when both are specified.

account.description: 1Password account domain. Sets OP_ACCOUNT environment variable.

userEmail.description: User email for 1Password account (optional, used when adding account).

disableInteractive.description: Disable interactive login prompt when no auth method is detected.

autoSsh.description: Automatically fetch and configure SSH keys from 1Password.

sshSecretNames.description: Comma-separated list of 1Password secret names containing SSH keys.

sshSecretTags.description: Tags to search for SSH secrets (used when sshSecretNames is empty).
